name: Blanc
source:
MBTI: ISFP

"...Nah. It's fine. Thanks for asking though... I guess... I think I might've just slept a bit rough last night. I mean, I'm never really high energy, but... yeah..."

The lethargic boy with a tendency to get lost in his own imagination. Unless recalling stories of him and his animal friends, Blanc tends to keep his voice down and his words brief. Only claiming he has no past of criminal history, Blanc appears to be keeping his composure on the surface. However, considering his blunt demeanour, there's no telling what true feelings might be hidden underneath.

[From [url=https://rainyholmes.itch.io/experiment-isolation]itch.io[/url]]
